about.description:
Hot Mic is a native macOS dictation app. A configurable global shortcut
starts a dictation, microphone audio is streamed to the ElevenLabs Scribe
v2 Realtime API, and the finalized text is copied to the clipboard. It is
a regular Dock app with a menu-bar control and a floating recording bar.

Using it requires an ElevenLabs account and API key with speech-to-text
access. The app is ad-hoc signed; the package installs `Hot Mic.app` under
`$PREFIX/Applications` and a `hot-mic` launcher in `bin`.
about.summary: Native macOS dictation app that streams audio to ElevenLabs Scribe Realtime

raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "0.2.0"
  # Pinned by Dictation.xcodeproj (exactVersion) and Package.resolved.
  keyboardshortcuts_version: "3.0.1"

package:
  name: hot-mic
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/dick-kinekt/hot-mic/releases/download/v${{ version }}/hot-mic-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: a1fbdc73452ad335ef6a0d948c7a75c053e0495f5e50689bcc3a223ef1e35690
    patches:
      # Point the Xcode project at the vendored KeyboardShortcuts checkout
      # below instead of resolving it from GitHub during the build.
      - patches/0001-use-local-keyboardshortcuts-package.patch
  # The only Swift package dependency. Vendored as a source so xcodebuild
  # never needs the network and its license ships with the package.
  - url: https://github.com/sindresorhus/KeyboardShortcuts/archive/refs/tags/${{ keyboardshortcuts_version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 0492d1cc6898170dbf850cf3bae65be88e42af72b27960c82731e3058ce990c4
    target_directory: KeyboardShortcuts

build:
  number: 0
  # Native macOS app (SwiftUI/AppKit, built with xcodebuild).
  skip: not osx
  script: build.sh
  dynamic_linking:
    # The .app bundle is ad-hoc signed with the hardened runtime and the
    # microphone entitlement. Rewriting rpaths or install names would break
    # that signature, so leave the Mach-O untouched.
    binary_relocation: false
  prefix_detection:
    # Same reason: the binary must not be patched at install time.
    ignore_binary_files: true

requirements:
  build:
    # Only here for the `__osx >=14.0` run export (see variants.yaml). The app
    # itself is compiled with the system Xcode; see build.sh.
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}

tests:
  - package_contents:
      strict: true
      files:
        exists:
          - Applications/Hot Mic.app/**
          - bin/hot-mic
          - Menu/hot-mic.json
          - Menu/hot-mic.icns
  - script:
      - test -x "$PREFIX/Applications/Hot Mic.app/Contents/MacOS/Hot Mic"
      - test -x "$PREFIX/bin/hot-mic"
      - plutil -lint "$PREFIX/Applications/Hot Mic.app/Contents/Info.plist"
      - /usr/bin/codesign --verify --deep --strict --verbose=2 "$PREFIX/Applications/Hot Mic.app"
      - /usr/bin/codesign -d --entitlements - "$PREFIX/Applications/Hot Mic.app" | grep -q com.apple.security.device.audio-input

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/dick-kinekt/hot-mic
  summary: Native macOS dictation app that streams audio to ElevenLabs Scribe Realtime
  description: |
    Hot Mic is a native macOS dictation app. A configurable global shortcut
    starts a dictation, microphone audio is streamed to the ElevenLabs Scribe
    v2 Realtime API, and the finalized text is copied to the clipboard. It is
    a regular Dock app with a menu-bar control and a floating recording bar.

    Using it requires an ElevenLabs account and API key with speech-to-text
    access. The app is ad-hoc signed; the package installs `Hot Mic.app` under
    `$PREFIX/Applications` and a `hot-mic` launcher in `bin`.
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
    - KeyboardShortcuts/license
  repository: https://github.com/dick-kinekt/hot-mic
  documentation: https://github.com/dick-kinekt/hot-mic#readme

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - tdejager
